task.title: Codex source discovery and durable ingestion receipts

intent.goal: Include all native Codex task sources in collection and make per-source delivery and raw token-payload evidence auditable.
must_happen: Automated, archived and continuing tasks remain eligible for raw collection.
Exact native-ID lookup bypasses reporting recency and row/database caps.
Validated receipts are durable before queued source deletion; token-payload presence is assessed before upload/normalization.
An explicit inventory reports received coverage or a specific exclusion/unresolved reason per selected source; incomplete scans fail coverage.
must_not_happen: Treat missing source, missing token payload or unacknowledged bytes as zero usage.
Rewrite raw telemetry or forge historical acknowledgements.
Traverse unsupported roots or symlinks to widen collection.
Claim the sampled remote sessions are repaired without collector-side evidence.
constraints: No production schema change is required for retained local receipts.
Use existing collector capture/drain and immutable server batch receipts.
non_goals: Remote machine installation without an available management channel
Continuous capture guarantees while the collector is not running
open_questions: The exact sampled collector files and historical acknowledgements are unavailable from this host.
Sharad native ID has not been supplied.
assumptions: Current native rollout roots are sessions and archived_sessions; other roots require explicit support.

proof_obligations.claim: All task-source categories and exact continued IDs can be discovered and captured.
proof_obligations.verification: SQLite/native file fixtures including archived/old/ninth database and an explicit no-hook backfill run.

proof_obligations.claim: Validated immutable receipts and scoped token-payload presence survive acknowledgement without lost queued data on failure.
proof_obligations.verification: Real local spool/filesystem tests for receipt mismatch, receipt-write failure, fragments, null payload and successful retries.

proof_obligations.claim: Inventory only claims received when matching source-byte ranges cover the snapshot; gaps/exclusions remain explicit.
proof_obligations.verification: End-to-end discovery/capture/drain/inventory tests, missing/outside-root sources and changed-byte receipt mismatch.
